title: Diaphragmatic Mitochondrial Myopathy in a Patient-Derived Mouse Model of Barth Syndrome.
intervention: TazD75H point mutant knock-in mouse model (TazPM)

outcomes.name: Diaphragmatic mitochondrial morphology
outcomes.effect_text: TazPM diaphragms exhibit structurally abnormal mitochondria

outcomes.name: Diaphragmatic compensatory remodeling under bioenergetic stress
outcomes.effect_text: survival-critical, bifurcated compensatory remodeling response to prevent fatal respiratory failure

outcomes.name: Global translation, ATP and NAD+ levels
outcomes.effect_text: halts global translation to conserve cellular ATP at the expense of reduced NAD+ levels

outcomes.name: Diaphragm motor unit fiber type composition
outcomes.effect_text: transitions into a highly specialized, slow-twitch motor system expected to reduce the energy cost per contraction
